title: Kissed Juicy Croatian Lamb Kebabs
description: Grassy and juicy lamb kebabs with an adventurous twist, featuring orange and steamed to perfection, this dish is halal friendly and perfect for a dinner gathering
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together orange juice, olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the lamb cubes onto the soaked wooden skewers
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10 minutes, turning occasionally
After 10 minutes, reduce the heat to medium low and steam the kebabs using a steamer basket for 5 minutes
Remove the kebabs from the heat and let rest for 5 minutes
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with rosemary and orange wedges
